name: Currency Minor Unit Lint
subtitle: Finds the money lines that send the wrong amount to a payment API: the x100 that charges 100x in JPY, the toFixed(2) that truncates KWD, and the currency codes that stopped being legal tender.
free: Checks the file you have open against all 24 rules and names every wrong amount, its currency, its ISO 4217 exponent and the date a code changed - no key, no limit, no watermark.
paid: Scans every file in the repository, fails a CI build before a wrong amount can merge, exports the findings as CSV, JSON or HTML, and rewrites the retired currency codes in place.
need_key: This option needs a licence (Currency Minor Unit Lint).
